needsVsWantsItems.name: Prescription Asthma Inhaler & Health Medication
needsVsWantsItems.explanation: Vital for basic health and survival. Essential medical expenses are always classified as strict Needs.

needsVsWantsItems.name: Latest Premium Wireless Noise-Cancelling Headphones
needsVsWantsItems.explanation: While convenient for studying, regular earphones serve the same basic function. Premium upgrades fall under discretionary Wants.

needsVsWantsItems.name: Monthly Public Transit Metro / Bus Pass
needsVsWantsItems.explanation: Essential for commuting to campus lectures, internships, or part-time employment.

needsVsWantsItems.name: Food Delivery App Order on a Friday Night
needsVsWantsItems.explanation: Groceries and home-prepared food are Needs, but restaurant delivery markups and delivery fees are elective Wants.

needsVsWantsItems.name: Required University Course Textbook
needsVsWantsItems.explanation: Essential educational requirement necessary to complete accredited coursework.

needsVsWantsItems.name: In-Game Battle Pass & Character Cosmetic Skin
needsVsWantsItems.explanation: Pure recreational entertainment. Should only be funded after all essential needs and savings goals are fulfilled.

knowledgeQuiz.question: Under the 50-30-20 budgeting guideline, what percentage of net income is recommended for Savings and Debt Repayment?
knowledgeQuiz.explanation: Correct! 20% is allocated toward building your emergency fund, future goals, and paying down debt.

knowledgeQuiz.question: What is the recommended 'Waiting Rule' before making an unplanned discretionary purchase to curb impulse spending?
knowledgeQuiz.explanation: Correct! The 48-Hour Rule allows emotional impulses to cool down, helping you evaluate whether you truly need the item.

knowledgeQuiz.question: Which of the following is considered a 'Fixed Expense' in a monthly budget?
knowledgeQuiz.explanation: Correct! Apartment rent remains constant each month, making it a predictable fixed essential expense.

knowledgeQuiz.question: What is the primary purpose of a Starter Emergency Fund for students?
options: To buy holiday gifts for friends
To cover unexpected crises (e.g. laptop breakdown, urgent dental visit) without incurring high-interest debt
knowledgeQuiz.explanation: Correct! A starter emergency buffer of $250-$500 protects you from taking high-interest loans when unexpected emergencies happen.
